snippet.title: Cosmic Tails (Official Release Trailer)
snippet.description:
Wishlist Cosmic Tails now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3621680/Cosmic_Tails

Play the FREE demo here!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3629930/Cosmic_Tails_Demo

Digging the Soundtrack? Pick up the Cosmic Tails OST today on Steam or via digital distribution!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3688700/Cosmic_Tails_Soundtrack
https://artists.landr.com/nubes_ix

Become the Cat Bounty Hunter. Blast off through deep space as you decimate hordes of space creatures with bounties on their heads. Upgrade unique cat-themed abilities, unlock pulverizing weapons, and survive until your contract expires -- or join the ranks of fallen bounty hunters before you.

Follow my socials!
https://linktr.ee/nubes_ix

Trailer Details:

Song Name: Encore
Artist: nubes_ix
Mixed and Mastered by: Steven Soucy (3rdEchoSounds)
Steven's Profile: https://soundbetter.com/profiles/684919-3rd-echo-sounds#reviewsanpham 
Edited by Voorny Media: https://www.fiverr.com/voorny?source=gig_cards&referrer_gig_slug=create-a-professional-hype-gaming-trailer-promo&ref_ctx_id=d70c604008c14435846696609adb64ee&imp_id=ae46fa4b-c045-4496-80b5-c44a48596f90
